description: A spreadsheet's structure with the ids batch_update_spreadsheet needs: per sheet its sheetId, size, frozen rows and columns, merges, conditional format rules (with their index), basic filter, filter views, protected and banded ranges, charts, slicers, tables and row/column groups, plus named ranges; ranges as A1. No cell data (get_values, read_rows). format raw returns the API's JSON for `ranges`, with grid data if asked, narrowed by `fields`: the way to read cell formats, notes, validation and pivots.

account.description: Which account: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Empty means the default account.

data_filters.description: format raw, instead of ranges: DataFilters choosing the grid data (developer metadata lookups included).

fields.description: format raw: a field mask over the Spreadsheet, e.g. "sheets(properties,data(rowData(values(userEnteredFormat,note))))".

include_grid_data.description: format raw: include each cell's data and formats for `ranges`.

ranges.description: format raw: A1 ranges to limit the grid data to.

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet's id, or its URL.

name: get_spreadsheet
title: Read a spreadsheet's structure
